Summary

CBACT02C is a batch COBOL program within the CardDemo application that sequentially reads all records from an indexed card data file and displays each card record to the output. The program opens the card file, iterates through every record printing its contents, and closes the file upon completion. It is a standalone main/driver program with no external program calls other than an abend utility.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: VSAM (Indexed) - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Display a message indicating the start of the card data file reading process 2: Card File Open - Open the card data file for sequential reading to prepare for processing all card records 3: Sequential Card Record Read - Read the next card record sequentially from the card data file one record at a time 4: End-of-File Detection - Detect when all card records have been read and signal the end of processing loop 5: Card Record Display - Display each card record's details (card number and associated card data) to the output 6: Card File Processing Loop - Continuously read and display all card records from the file until the end of file is reached 7: Card File Close - Close the card data file after all records have been read and displayed 8: Program Completion - Display a message indicating the successful end of the card data file reading and printing process 9: Error Reporting - Display a meaningful error status message when a failure occurs during file open, read, or close operations 10: Abnormal Program Termination - Terminate the program abnormally when a critical file error is encountered during card file processing

DISPLAY 'ABENDING PROGRAM' MOVE 0 TO TIMING MOVE 999 TO ABCODE CALL 'CEE3ABD'. ``` Card File Processing Loop - End of File Check-L_7: ```cobol PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' PERFORM 1000-CARDFILE-GET-NEXT IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' DISPLAY CARD-RECORD END-IF END-IF END-PERFORM. ``` Sequential Card Record Read-L_8: ```cobol READ CARDFILE-FILE INTO CARD-RECORD. ``` End-of-File Detection After Card Record Read-L_9: ```cobol IF CARDFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE IF CARDFILE-STATUS = '10' MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE IF APPL-EOF MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR READING CARDFILE' MOVE CARDFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF END-IF ``` Card Record Display-L_10: ```cobol IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' DISPLAY CARD-RECORD END-IF ``` Card File Read Error Reporting-L_11: ```cobol DISPLAY 'ERROR READING CARDFILE' MOVE CARDFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS ``` Abnormal Program Termination on Card File Read Error-L_12: ```cobol PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM ``` ```cobol 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM. Rule: Open Card Data File for Sequential Reading-L1: ```cobol OPEN INPUT CARDFILE-FILE ``` Rule: Card File Open Success Validation-L2: ```cobol IF CARDFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING CARDFILE' MOVE CARDFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Rule: Card File Ready for Processing-L3: ```cobol IF CARDFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ``` Rule: Display Error Notification on Card File Open Failure-L4: ```cobol DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING CARDFILE' ``` Rule: Display Detailed File Status Information on Open Failure-L5: ```cobol MOVE CARDFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS ``` Rule: Abnormal Program Termination on Card File Open Failure-L6: ```cobol PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM ```
